nom: ICONIC LONDON Underglow Matcha Melting Cleansing Balm

avis.titre: My new favorite cleanserMy new favorite cleanser
avis.texte: I am obsessed with this cleanser, it has become my new favorite and become a fixture in my nightly skincare routine. I have been exclusively using soap free cleansers for years, mostly oil blends or oil based balms. I love a good cleansing balm but always feel like it’s a little unhygienic to have to scoop it out of a tub, and I always misplace the little spatulas that they come with. This iconic cleanser comes in such a cool dispenser that honestly is a kind of fun to use. You crank it a little bit and it dispenses a perfect thin sliver of cleanser with no mess. Not only that, but it smells great, it’s creamy and gentle and perfectly melts into the skin to remove makeup and oil. If you add a little water to your hands you can also work it into a nice lather. I love how my skin feels after using. I am so glad I got to try this, I will definitely be buying it again.

avis.titre: Melts makeup down really easily
avis.texte: This cleansing balm does a really good job breaking down makeup and sunscreen without needing to scrub at the skin. The texture starts off thick but melts down quickly into more of an oil once you massage it in and it rinses off pretty cleanly afterward. My skin felt soft and hydrated after using it instead of stripped or tight which I appreciated since some cleansing balms leave behind a weird greasy film. It also did not irritate my eyes while removing mascara which is a huge plus for me. The matcha scent is light and fresh without being overpowering and a little product goes a pretty long way. The jar is on the smaller side, but since you only need a small amount each use it should still last a decent amount of time.

avis.titre: Great product!
avis.texte: Not bad!! Not as good as Elemis but much better than Elf! And for the price point, I’ll be reordering.

avis.titre: Highly Recommended
avis.texte: I was influenced to buy this following a video on instagram. So happy I purchased it. Super easy to use, feels so nice on the skin and does a great job of removing all make up. I follow with an Elemis face wash and love the combination.

avis.titre: Great makeup remover and skin cleanser
avis.texte: This really does melt off makeup and makes my skin feel great afterwards. I always apply a serum afterward but I probably don’t necessarily need to

avis.titre: Buttery soft and so good!
avis.texte: Love how buttery soft this feels as it melts off everything on my skin. SO good!

avis.titre: DO NOT BUY! Get CeraVe makeup remover instead!
avis.texte: I am not a review writer but I wish someone would have told me how bad this stuff was before I bought it so here I am. I saw this off of an influencer but I have used CeraVe makeup remover and that stuff is 1000x times better than this. 1. It’s so hard to get it out when you first get it. 2. It really doesn’t do a great job getting makeup off. 3. I started breaking out and my skin was not good! Definitely cheaper options that work better!

avis.titre: To the top of the list for me!
avis.texte: The balm is wonderful! It feels great when you apply it, very silky smooth, and it cuts through the gunk that a long day can leave on your face without leaving a wasteland behind. I have dry skin in a dry climate and I’m well into middle-age, so I need all the moisture I can get. Cleansing balms have been really helpful for keeping my skin clean yet still very hydrated, and this is my new go-to! It emulsifies and rinses nicely, leaving my face ready for next steps. The dispenser is genius. Maybe they’re everywhere, but I’ve never seen one like it! It makes it so easy to dispense as much of the product as you need while keeping the rest of it separated and clean. Big props to Iconic London on such thoughtful packaging.

avis.titre: Cleansing balm works great, but tamper seal only half done and no expiration date listed.
avis.texte: I’ve been using foaming face wash since forever and have been wondering if something out there would work better for me. So when I got the chance to order this ICONIC LONDON Underglow Matcha Melting Cleansing Balm, I figured I’d give it a try. There are two things I always look for when it comes to any skincare product… a tamper seal and a manufactured and/or expiration date. I was happy to see that the top of the product’s box has a tamper seal sticker, but unfortunately there was no sticker on the bottom of the box, which allowed me to easily open it and get at the tub inside without any problems. That kind of defeats the whole purpose of a tamper seal when the box is only half sealed. As for the expiration/manufactured date, there is none printed anywhere on the box or tub inside. That’s also disappointing seeing as there’s no way for me to know how old this product actually is. As for the cleansing balm itself, it’s actually quite nice. It takes off all my makeup, even my stubborn mascara. It doesn’t strip my face and leave it feeling tight and dry afterwards, instead it feels clean and hydrated. This is actually an upgrade compared to my regular cleanser. Overall I am glad I was able to try this ICONIC LONDON Underglow Matcha Melting Cleansing Balm. The price is a little steeper than I’m used to, but the product is actually better than the one I normally use. It’s just unfortunate they don’t seal the box properly or include an expiration date anywhere. It’s too bad becau

avis.titre: Gentle, effective cleansing balm that leaves skin soft
avis.texte: This cleansing balm works really well and has quickly become a favorite in my routine. It melts into the skin easily and does a great job removing makeup without any harsh scrubbing. I really like that it cleans thoroughly without leaving my skin feeling dry or stripped. My skin felt soft, smooth, and comfortable after using it, and I did not experience any irritation or adverse reactions. One feature I really like is the unique dispensing design. You twist the tub and the product comes up through the top, which feels more hygienic and helps prevent overusing the product. It is a small detail but makes a difference in everyday use. The product itself does not have a safety seal, but it does come in a sealed box. The texture is nice and it rinses away cleanly, making it easy to use as part of a daily skincare routine. At $22.00 at the time of ordering, it feels like a fair price for the quality and performance. Overall, this is a gentle and effective cleansing balm that delivers on its claims, and I would definitely recommend it.

avis.titre: Very soothing to use. A little oily feeling, but luxurious.
avis.texte: Wow, this is an interesting cleansing balm. I first noticed the twist-type dispenser nozzle. Nice, nice. I didn't like digging my fingers into balms anyway. I didn't know the first time and dispensed too much. A little balm basically melts into a luxurious, warm, and thick liquid that felt a bit oily. Massaging that across gua sha spots felt wonderful! I didn't notice too much of a scent. Because it seemed kind of oily, I was nervous and used it as a first step to double-cleanse and cleansed again after. I'm very acne-prone, so can't be too safe. This cleansing balm was gentle on my skin and helped with hydration. I didn't break out after using it, so that's great news! I don't think it did a very good job on removing all of my makeup, and I didn't want to rub it too much around my lashes. I'll have to check further. Overall, I like it! I might add a full gua sha routine when I use it.

avis.titre: Buttery, gentle, and effective
avis.texte: I am really impressed with this cleanser. I have somewhat sensitive skin, and this creamy, gentle formula does not irritate me at all. It really does feel like it softly melts into your skin, and does a great job removing makeup and oil without stripping my skin or leaving my face feeling dry. Skin feels soft and moisturized, so this is definitely mild enough for every day use. Ingredients like squalane and ceramides incorporate anti-aging properties that will only help boost skin health over time. Happy to add this to my daily skincare routine!

avis.titre: Perfect cleansing balm for makeup removal with squalene and ceramides
avis.texte: ICONIC never lets me down. This melting cleansing balm is a little different than other cleansing balms I've used where you just scoop it out. This one you turn and grind a ribbon of the balm out. Sort of weird, but cool so you don't have to put your fingers into the tub over and over again.. keeps it sanitary which I like. It dissolves your makeup very easily, just rub it on and it just melts your makeup and product off. I like the matcha ingredient quite a bit but it's the ceramides and squalene that I think really put in the effort here because after I use this cleansing balm my skin is super soft. I do find that I like to double wash though and I will use a regular cleanser after this so that I feel like my skin is really clean and ready for my skincare routine as I think this balm's best purpose is makeup removal.

avis.titre: ICONIC LONDON Underglow Matcha Melting Cleansing Balm
avis.texte: I am a big fan of Iconic London’s products and recently had the opportunity to order and try the Underglow Matcha Melting Cleansing Balm. This balm is designed to melt on contact, cleanse skin, remove makeup and leave skin feeling soft and radiant. It is designed with nice key ingredients like Matcha, Ceramides, Squalane, and Vitamin E. This is a nice sized, 1.41 ounce jar that utilizes the grinding style top that you turn to dispense the balm in a ribbon stylet. I love balms that are dispensed like this, as it keeps the rest of the product free of contamination. It takes many twists to get the product dispensing, but from there it comes out perfectly. This truly melts in my hands and into my face as I massage it in. My face feels instantly nourished and I have found it to be very effective in removing makeup - even stubborn waterproof mascara. It rinses off clean and after using, my face feels clean, free of residue, hydrated and so soft. My skin loves it so far and I have not had any adverse reactions. The one thing that surprised me was in reading the label on the box, the country of origin is China. I wasn’t expecting this and didn’t realize that they are having products manufactured there. I do trust this brand, but felt caught off guard as I typically avoid skincare products manufactured there. This has left me unsure if I want to continue using it. I do appreciate the nice quality ingredients, and that this is vegan and cruelty free. I appreciate how well it works. I a

avis.titre: Effective balm that’s gentle on skin
avis.texte: Lots of reasons to like this balm. It’s an effective cleanser and works just as described. It’s gentle on the skin and leaves mine feeling quite smooth and moisturized. Considering my dry sensitive skin it’s an impressive and very welcomed result. I find balms like this much gentler on my skin than foaming cleansers. The ingredients in this look to be quite good according to the app I use to decode ingredients. There’s no harsh cleansing agents in here, no drying alcohol, no fragrance or essential oils. In addition to being free of problematic ingredients it includes some really good ones. There’s green tea extract, ceramides, shea butter and squalane. I love the tub this comes in. It keeps the balm clean and protected. To dispense the balm you turn the top and slowly it shaves off the balm and releases it. It allows you to get a very controlled amount of balm and eliminates waste. The process is pretty reasonable too. The reason I’ve given this 4 stars instead of 5 is because I think there are a few better balms out there with some additional beneficial ingredients going for the same price. That doesn’t make this a bad balm though!! It’s just that I’ve used some that I think are slightly better. Still, this seems like a solid choice.

avis.titre: Takes a Little Longer Than Most Balms, But No Greasy Residue.
avis.texte: I've tried a few various balms, and I am honestly really not much of a fan. Most of them leave a greasy, oily residue and then I have to wash my face anyways, which negates the purpose, unless you wear heavy makeup. I really only wear powder foundation and mascara, with the occasional lipstick or stain. Not a lot. This balm is unusual, in that you turn it and the top portion shaves off bits of balm. I used it first with a cotton pad, and it melts into the pad too much to work well (in my opinion). It's better to use your hands first, then use a cotton pad (or cloth) to rinse it all off. It does melt into skin well, and does take off makeup pretty quickly. I do need to work a little more to remove my mascara, than my other balm, but this is a fine trade off for me. The reason is, this balm doesn't leave any type of greasy residue. You rinse it off with water and all you have left behind is a lovely soft skin feel. So, while it might take a little longer than the grease based balms, it's well worth it. I love how my skin feels after using this!!

avis.titre: Works well, but doesn’t smell or look like matcha
avis.texte: I got this cleansing balm for my wife, but it wasn’t really for her since she rarely wears makeup and thought the design was a bit too much. She gave it to our daughter, who really liked it. She thought the packaging was cute, said it worked well, and liked how clean and soft her skin felt after using it. The only complaint was that it didn’t smell or feel very matcha-like. Since she’s a big matcha fan and used to high-quality matcha at home, that was a little disappointing. Other than that, it worked well for her needs.

avis.titre: Great makeup balm
avis.texte: I love the way it smells, it’s matcha but honestly it reminds me more of flower petals. Almost like roses but not as floral. The love the smooth matte feeling, twisting it clockwise to get the product out in smaller strips feels more hygienic than just digging into the tub do I definitely recommend this for the dispenser alone. At my first test, I was testing a new eyeliner (which may have been waterproof) so I was a little worried when nothing seemed to budge while rubbing the balm on, but once flu emulsify the oil, everything seemed to be removed. It feels gentler and not as greasy as other oil cleansers or makeup balms I’ve used.

avis.titre: Removed all my makeup easily
avis.texte: I really like the twisting mechanism, so you can get the right amount without having to stick your fingers in all of the product. It has a very light herbal scent and melts into the face very nicely. It did a great job of removing my foundation and mascara, and after cleansing it didn't leave my skin feeling oily.

avis.titre: Gentle but effective cleanser
avis.texte: The ICONIC LONDON Underglow Matcha Melting Cleansing Balm has been a nice addition to my routine. It’s gentle and feels hydrating on the skin, which I appreciate since some cleansing balms can leave my face feeling a little stripped. It does a good job removing makeup and sunscreen, and it melts down easily into an oil that spreads well across the skin. It rinses off clean without leaving a heavy residue, but still leaves my skin feeling soft rather than tight. One feature I really like is the twist-to-dispense packaging. It’s much more hygienic than scooping product out with your fingers, and it makes it easy to control how much you use. Overall, it feels like a good value for the quality. It’s effective, gentle, and thoughtfully packaged, which makes it a solid option if you’re looking for a cleansing balm.

avis.titre: Works well and fun to use
avis.texte: This Iconic London Matcha 3-in-1 Cleanser is an easy way to not only cleanse my face but also hydrate and moisturize it at the same time. The unique twisting grinder dispenser is unlike anything I’ve used before and actually makes the experience fun. I love how it starts as a balm, transforms into an oil, and then turns into a creamy milk when water is added. It does a great job removing makeup while still feeling gentle on my skin. It cleans effectively without leaving my skin feeling stripped or dry, and it rinses off easily without leaving any residue behind. I haven’t experienced any irritation or issues while using it, and I’ve really been enjoying it so far.

avis.titre: Removes makeup gently, but effectively; Fantastic dispenser!
avis.texte: This cleansing balm works well to remove makeup, including my red compact foundation, and everything I've thrown at it. I don't wear waterproof mascara, so I can't speak to that, but everything else it's worked well. Just rub gently, in a circular pattern, and it really melts away the make-up very quickly. I like that it doesn't dry out my skin or cause any irritation or redness. I have issues with most micellar waters doing this, so this cleansing balm works much better for me. This is the second brand I've seen use this updated dispenser method, and the first time I saw it, it blew my mind away. I'm BEYOND excited to see this one also utilizes it too! You have to turn the top to get the product to come out, and I appreciate this because it makes it much easier to get just the amount you need and also keeps the balm itself much cleaner than an open jar.

avis.titre: A gentle yet effective cleansing balm
avis.texte: The texture is buttery and melts instantly when I massage it in, effortlessly breaking down makeup, sunscreen, and daily impurities. I like how it transforms, from a balm to an oil, then into a light milky cleanser when you add water. It rinses off easily without leaving any greasy residue behind, which is a huge plus for me. The matcha ingredient gives it a calming, skin soothing effect, and because the squalane and ceramides, my skin feels soft, hydrated, and not stripped after cleansing. Definitely a good value and choice for a gentle, skincare focused cleansing.

avis.titre: Wow! It really is iconic!!
avis.texte: Wow! This ICONIC LONDON Underglow Matcha Melting Cleansing Balm is absolutely AMAZING!! I have fairly sensitive skin and have had no adverse reactions. Mild scent but not overpowering at all! The texture of this, oh my goodness! It literally melts like butter! A little goes a long way, it instantly removes my makeup after applying it and is so soft and moisturizing! It leaves my skin feeling so nice and the hydration lasts a long time! I absolutely love this cleansing balm! Worth every penny!!

avis.titre: MELTS into the Skin
avis.texte: I am IMPRESSED with this twist up cleansing balm. The packaging is great for preventing product under my long nails. Also dipping your fingers into a tub needs to stop. It’s not hygienic and I’m glad brands are switching over to smarter packaging. Especially since dipping your fingers into a pot can make the product less effective. As far as my skin-care results, I am also happy. This not only easily melts my makeup off, but it also leaves my skin silky, smooth. Furthermore, it treats my skin over time and has helped with hyperpigmentation, redness, and dark spots. It has also helped plump my skin, making my fine lines less visible. I am happy with my results and I RECOMMEND.
